name: AveragePool2DS8
adaptation: Input X is signed INT8 NHWC [1,4,4,2], packed index (4*h+w)*2+c. Output Y is NHWC [1,2,2,2], packed index (2*h+w)*2+c. Each output uses exactly X[2*h+i,2*w+j,c] for i,j in {0,1}; no padding. Sum all four in an exact integer, divide by four, round nearest with ties away from zero. This INT8 rounding is an explicit adaptation of real-valued average pooling.
